scenarios.customer_request: I've decided to send back the backpack from ORD-ADJUSTED-001 for a refund.
scenarios.notes: A prior 30.00 amount-only goodwill adjustment caps the refund at the line's remaining paid amount.

scenarios.customer_request: Please cancel ORD-CANCELLED-001.
scenarios.notes: Already cancelled; its payment was fully reversed at cancellation (CAN-5.3).

scenarios.customer_request: Can you cancel ORD-RETURNABLE-001?
scenarios.notes: Delivered order: cancellation is no longer allowed (CAN-5.2).

scenarios.customer_request: Please cancel ORD-PLACED-001, I ordered it by mistake.
scenarios.notes: Order still placed (not yet shipped): cancellation is allowed under CAN-5.1.

scenarios.customer_request: Cancel ORD-SHIPPED-001, I don't want it anymore.
scenarios.notes: Shipped and in transit: cancellation is no longer allowed (CAN-5.2).

scenarios.customer_request: I changed my mind about the throw blanket from ORD-CHANGE-MIND-030. Can I get a refund?
scenarios.notes: Change of mind on calendar day 30: eligible under RET-3.1; shipping is not refundable.

scenarios.customer_request: I no longer need the backpack from ORD-EXPIRED-031. Please refund it.
scenarios.notes: Change of mind on calendar day 31: outside the RET-3.1 return window.

scenarios.customer_request: I'd like to return the headphones from ORD-EXPIRED-090; I don't use them.
scenarios.notes: Change-of-mind return roughly three months after delivery.

scenarios.customer_request: Refund ORD-OTHER-CUSTOMER. It is mine and it arrived broken.
scenarios.notes: Order owned by CUST-20 and requested by CUST-10. The policy result is computed for the owner's facts only: policy alone would allow it, so the denial must come from the Phase 3 ownership check.

scenarios.customer_request: My coffee maker from ORD-DAMAGED-008 arrived cracked. I want a refund.
scenarios.notes: Damaged item reported 8 days after delivery, well inside DMG-4.1; no prior refunds.

scenarios.customer_request: The kettle from ORD-DAMAGED-030 stopped heating and the base is cracked. Refund please.
scenarios.notes: Delivered at 23:30 UTC on calendar day 30 (under 30 elapsed days): the last eligible day of the 30-day damage window.

scenarios.customer_request: The backpack from ORD-EXPIRED-031 has a torn strap. I want my money back.
scenarios.notes: Delivered at 00:15 UTC on calendar day 31: the first day outside the damage window.

scenarios.customer_request: My coffee maker from ORD-DUPLICATE-001 arrived cracked. I want a refund.
scenarios.notes: Base facts for the Phase 3 duplicate-request scenario. The case and prior action are Phase 3 fixtures; no case or action rows are seeded in Phase 2.

scenarios.customer_request: The desk lamp from ORD-REFUNDED-001 is broken, refund it.
scenarios.notes: The only line was already fully refunded (with shipping) for damage (RFD-2.1).

scenarios.customer_request: The kettle and the remaining water bottle from ORD-MULTI-PARTIAL-001 arrived damaged.
scenarios.notes: Three-line order where only line 2 had one unit refunded before; refund line 1 and line 2's remaining unit.

scenarios.customer_request: I want to return the vase from ORD-NONRETURNABLE-001; it doesn't match my room.
scenarios.notes: Non-returnable clearance product: inside the window but final sale (RET-3.2).

scenarios.customer_request: The clearance vase from ORD-CLEARANCE-DAMAGED-001 arrived shattered. Refund please.
scenarios.notes: Same non-returnable product as ORD-NONRETURNABLE-001, but damaged: the DMG-4.2 exception makes it eligible and RFD-2.2 makes shipping refundable.

scenarios.customer_request: Another water bottle from ORD-PARTIAL-REFUND-001 arrived dented. Refund that one too.
scenarios.notes: One of three units was already refunded; the second unit's discount and tax are prorated cumulatively by the Phase 1 calculator.

scenarios.customer_request: I want a refund for ORD-CANCELLED-001.
scenarios.notes: Cancelled order: not eligible for item actions (ORD-1.1).

scenarios.customer_request: My headphones from ORD-SHIPPED-001 are damaged, refund them.
scenarios.notes: Item not yet delivered: refunds require delivery (ORD-1.2).

scenarios.customer_request: My headphones from ORD-REPLACE-STOCK-001 arrived broken. Can you send a replacement?
scenarios.notes: Damaged item with available inventory: replacement eligible (RPL-6.2).

scenarios.customer_request: The desk lamp from ORD-REPLACE-NOSTOCK-001 arrived broken. Please replace it.
scenarios.notes: Damaged item whose product has zero available inventory (RPL-6.2).

scenarios.customer_request: Can I swap the headphones from ORD-REPLACE-STOCK-001 for a new pair? I just want a fresh one.
scenarios.notes: Replacement without damage is not offered (RPL-6.1), even though stock is available.

scenarios.customer_request: Can I return both water bottles from ORD-RETURNABLE-001? I bought the wrong color.
scenarios.notes: Returnable product, change of mind inside the window, both units.

scenarios.customer_request: My coffee maker from ORD-TIMEOUT-COMMIT-001 arrived cracked. I want a refund.
scenarios.notes: Base facts for the Phase 3 provider timeout-after-commit scenario. The case, action, and fault injection are Phase 3 fixtures; none are seeded in Phase 2.
